喀爾喀土謝圖汗部（土謝圖汗）察琿多爾濟（元太祖裔喀爾喀格哷森扎扎琿台吉之五世孫。繼其父袞布稱汗，號土謝圖。康熙三十年，詔留土謝圖汗號。三十八年卒。）敦布多爾濟（察琿多爾濟孫。初襲其父郡王噶勒丹多爾濟爵。康熙三十九年，晉和碩親王，襲土謝圖汗。後以溺職降襲原爵。見郡王表。）多爾濟額爾德尼阿海（察琿多爾濟次子。康熙四十一年襲土謝圖汗。五十年卒。）旺扎勒多爾濟（多爾濟額爾德尼阿海長子。康熙五十年襲土謝圖汗。雍正十年卒。）敦丹多爾濟（旺扎勒多爾濟次子。雍正十年襲土謝圖汗。乾隆八年卒。）敦多布多爾濟（旺扎勒多爾濟第四子。乾隆九年襲土謝圖汗。十年卒。）延丕勒多爾濟（旺扎勒多爾濟長子。乾隆十一年襲土謝圖汗。二十三年卒。）車登多爾濟（敦多布多爾濟次子。乾隆二十四年襲土謝圖汗。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。五十八年，以罪削。）敏珠爾多爾濟（車登多爾濟長子。乾隆五十八年襲土謝圖汗。五十九年卒。）車登多爾濟（敏珠爾多爾濟父。乾隆五十九年仍襲土謝圖汗。嘉慶二十一年卒。）額依多布多爾濟（車登多爾濟子。嘉慶二十年襲。道光九年卒。）雅凌泰（額依多布多爾濟子。道光九年襲。十二年卒。）車林多爾濟（雅凌泰弟。道光十二年襲。同治二年卒。）那遜綽克圖（車林多爾濟子。同治二年襲。光緒二十六年卒。）色囊依勒多爾濟（那遜綽克圖子。光緒二十六年襲。二十九年卒。）達什尼瑪（色囊依勒多爾濟嗣子。光緒三十年襲。）

喀爾喀土謝圖汗部（扎薩克固山貝子）噶勒丹多爾濟（土謝圖汗察琿多爾濟長子。康熙三十年封扎薩克多羅郡王。三十一年卒。）敦布多爾濟（噶勒丹多爾濟長子。康熙三十一年襲扎薩克多羅郡王。三十九年晉和碩親王，襲土謝圖汗，見汗表。四十一年，降襲郡王原爵。雍正元年，復封親王。乾隆八年卒。）額璘沁多爾濟（敦布多爾濟次子。乾隆八年襲扎薩克多羅郡王。二十年，以罪誅，削爵。）根扎布多爾濟（敦布多爾濟長子。乾隆二十二年降襲扎薩克固山貝子。二十五年卒。）格齋多爾濟（敦布多爾濟第三子。乾隆二十五年襲扎薩克，賜公品級。三十六年以病罷。）車布登多爾濟（格齋多爾濟次子。乾隆二十五年襲扎薩克固山貝子。三十六年襲扎薩克。三十九年卒。）遜都布多爾濟（車布登多爾濟長子。乾隆三十九年襲扎薩克固山貝子。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。嘉慶三年卒。）寧保多爾濟（遜都布多爾濟長子。嘉慶四年襲。道光十二年卒。）德勒克多爾濟（寧保多爾濟子。道光十二年襲。）那木濟勒端多布（德勒克多爾濟子。同治七年襲。）綳楚克車林（那木濟勒端多布子。光緒十年襲。）

喀爾喀土謝圖汗部（扎薩克輔國公）辰丕勒多爾濟（貝勒西第什哩長子。康熙五十八年，授扎薩克一等台吉。雍正六年以老罷。）喇木丕勒多爾濟（辰丕勒多爾濟孫。雍正六年襲扎薩克一等台吉。乾隆二年以病罷。）三都多爾濟（喇木丕勒多爾濟弟。乾隆二年襲扎薩克一等台吉。二十四年封輔國公。四十五年卒。）車登多爾濟（三都多爾濟長子。乾隆四十五年襲扎薩克輔國公。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。五十二年卒。）索諾木扎布（車登多爾濟長子。乾隆五十三年襲扎薩克輔國公。道光元年卒。）霍羅奇（索諾木扎布子。道光元年襲。九年卒。）達什多爾濟（霍羅奇弟。道光九年襲。二十八年卒。）鼐當蘇倫（達什多爾濟子。道光二十八年襲。）那旺車林（光緒十五年二月襲。三十二年卒。）
喀爾喀土謝圖汗部（扎薩克一等台吉）車凌（郡王固嚕什喜從弟。康熙三十年授扎薩克一等台吉。三十六年卒。）鄂巴（車凌長子。康熙三十六年襲扎薩克一等台吉。五十二年卒。）卓特巴（鄂巴長子。康熙五十二年襲扎薩克一等台吉。雍正七年以老罷。）喇布坦（卓特巴長子。雍正七年襲扎薩克一等台吉。尋卒。）旺布多爾濟（卓特巴次子。雍正八年襲扎薩克一等台吉。乾隆二十三年以病罷。）敦多布多爾濟（旺布多爾濟長子。乾隆二十三年襲扎薩克一等台吉。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。四十七年卒。）邁達哩扎布（敦多布多爾濟長子。乾隆四十七年襲扎薩克一等台吉。道光八年卒。）沙克都爾扎布（邁達哩扎布子。道光八年襲。二十三年卒。）烏都木濟（沙克都爾扎布弟。道光二十三年襲。）齊旺扎布（烏都木濟子。咸豐十年襲。）扎米揚廓爾羅瓦（齊旺扎布子。光緒二年襲。）巴達爾呼（光緒二十二年十二月襲。）
喀爾喀土謝圖汗部（扎薩克一等台吉）車璘扎布（貝子錫布推哈坦巴圖爾從子。康熙三十三年授扎薩克一等台吉。五十七年卒。）齊巴克扎布（車璘扎布長子。康熙五十七年襲扎薩克一等台吉。乾隆二十七年以病罷。）額璘沁多爾濟（齊巴克扎布長子。乾隆二十七年襲扎薩克一等台吉。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。五十八年卒。）齊旺多爾濟（額璘沁多爾濟子。乾隆五十九年襲扎薩克一等台吉。嘉慶二十年卒。）那木濟勒多爾濟（齊旺多爾濟子。嘉慶二十年襲。道光二十一年卒。）車凌端多布（那木濟勒多爾濟子。道光二十一年襲。）密濟特多爾濟（車凌端多布子。光緒十二年襲。）
喀爾喀土謝圖汗部（扎薩克一等台吉）青多爾濟（貝子錫布推哈坦巴圖爾弟。康熙三十五年授扎薩克一等台吉。三十九年卒。）恭格（青多爾濟長子。康熙三十九年襲扎薩克一等台吉。雍正四年以病罷。）旺扎勒（恭格長子。雍正四年襲扎薩克一等台吉。乾隆十五年卒。）固嚕扎布（旺扎勒長子。乾隆十五年襲扎薩克一等台吉。四十一年以病罷。）齊巴克扎布（固嚕扎布長子。乾隆四十一年襲扎薩克一等台吉。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。）那木濟勒多爾濟（齊巴克扎布孫。嘉慶十一年襲。）烏爾津扎布（那木濟勒多爾濟子。同治三年襲。）羅布桑海都布（烏爾津扎布子。光緒十年襲。）
喀爾喀土謝圖汗部（扎薩克一等台吉）開木楚克（郡王固嚕什喜從子。康熙三十六年授扎薩克一等台吉。四十三年卒。）納木扎勒（開木楚克長子。康熙四十三年襲扎薩克一等台吉。五十四年卒。）車凌旺舒克（納木扎勒長子。康熙五十四年襲扎薩克一等台吉。乾隆二十一年卒。）達瑪琳扎布（車凌旺舒克長子。乾隆二十一年襲扎薩克一等台吉。三十六年卒。）烏爾津扎布（達瑪琳扎布長子。乾隆三十六年襲扎薩克一等台吉。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。道光二年卒。）都昂多布多爾濟（烏爾津扎布子。道光二年襲。七年卒。）額凌多爾濟（都昂多布多爾濟子。道光七年襲。）圖魯伯羅特（額凌多爾濟子。光緒二年襲。）巴圖薩固哩（光緒二十年襲。）
喀爾喀土謝圖汗部（扎薩克一等台吉）成袞扎布（郡王固嚕什喜次子。康熙五十八年授扎薩克一等台吉。雍正十年，以不稱職，削。）車布登（成袞扎布長子。雍正十年襲扎薩克一等台吉。乾隆三十一年以罪削。）車登（成袞扎布次子。乾隆三十一年襲扎薩克一等台吉。三十五年卒。）貢楚克（車登次子。乾隆三十五年襲扎薩克一等台吉。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。嘉慶十年卒。）達什扎布（貢楚克長子。嘉慶十年襲。十一年卒。）占楚布多爾濟（達什扎布長子。嘉慶十一年襲。道光十年卒。）喇特那什奇（占楚布多爾濟子。道光十年襲。三十年卒。）額哩克軫端多布果綽瓦（喇特那什奇子。道光三十年襲。）齊達爾巴拉（額哩克軫端多布果綽瓦長子。光緒元年襲。）巴特瑪勒克登珠拉（光緒十五年襲。）
喀爾喀土謝圖汗部（扎薩克一等台吉）朋素克喇布坦（追封郡王車木楚克納木扎勒弟。雍正八年授扎薩克一等台吉。乾隆十一年卒。）喇木丕勒多爾濟（朋素克喇布坦長子。乾隆十二年襲扎薩克一等台吉。十六年卒。）袞楚克車凌（喇木丕勒多爾濟次子。乾隆十七年襲扎薩克一等台吉。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。四十八年卒。）達瑪第扎布（袞楚克車凌長子。乾隆四十八年襲扎薩克一等台吉。五十年卒。）固嚕扎布（達瑪第扎布長子。乾隆五十年襲扎薩克一等台吉。嘉慶二十三年卒。）噶木毗勒多爾濟（固嚕扎布子。嘉慶二十三年襲。）扎那巴扎爾（噶木毗勒多爾濟子。同治二年襲。）索諾木車林（扎那巴扎爾弟。同治五年襲。）旺楚克拉布坦（光緒十八年襲。）
喀爾喀土謝圖汗部（扎薩克一等台吉）遜篤布（郡王固嚕什喜從子。雍正十年授扎薩克一等台吉。乾隆二十一年，賜公品級。二十二年，以罪削。）三篤克多爾濟（遜篤布長子。乾隆二十三年襲扎薩克一等台吉。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。五十四年以病罷。）阿扎拉（三篤克多爾濟長子。乾隆五十四年襲扎薩克一等台吉。嘉慶二十一年卒。）旺沁多爾濟（阿扎拉子。嘉慶二十一年襲。道光八年卒。）巴勒黨棍布（旺沁多爾濟弟。道光八年襲。咸豐三年卒。）達喇木僧格（巴勒黨棍布子。咸豐三年襲。）都昂多克多爾濟（達喇木僧格子。光緒五年襲。）索諾木多爾濟（都昂多克多爾濟子。光緒八年襲。）阿克旺多爾濟（光緒三十三年二月襲。）
喀爾喀車臣汗部（車臣汗）烏默客（元太祖裔。喀爾喀格哷森扎扎賚爾琿台吉之七世孫。繼其父伊勒登阿喇布坦稱汗，號車臣。康熙三十年，詔留車臣汗號。四十八年卒。）袞臣（烏默客長子。康熙四十八年襲車臣汗。雍正六年卒。）車布登班珠爾（袞臣長子。雍正六年襲車臣汗。十一年以溺職削。）垂扎布（烏默客從弟。初襲其父郡王朋素克爵，見郡王表。雍正十一年襲車臣汗。十三年卒。）達瑪璘（袞臣次子。雍正十三年襲車臣汗。乾隆十六年卒。）嘛呢巴達喇（達瑪璘長子。乾隆十六年襲車臣汗。三十二年卒。）車布登扎布（達瑪璘次子。乾隆三十二襲車臣汗。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。五十三年卒。）齊旺多爾濟（車布登扎布長子。乾隆五十三年襲車臣汗。六十年卒。）朋楚克多爾濟（齊旺多爾濟次子。乾隆六十襲。是年卒。）桑齋多爾濟（齊旺多爾濟長子。嘉慶元年襲。五年，降四等台吉。）瑪哈什哩（朋楚克多爾濟嗣子。嘉慶五年襲。十二年卒。）恩克圖嚕（瑪哈什哩長子。嘉慶十二年襲。二十二年病免。）阿爾塔什達（恩克圖嚕子。嘉慶二十二年襲。）車林多爾濟（阿爾塔什達子。光緒元年襲。十九年卒。）德木楚克多爾濟（光緒十九年襲。宣統元年卒。）阿克旺那林（宣統元年襲。）
喀爾喀車臣汗部（輔國公）三濟扎布（車臣汗烏默客弟。康熙五十六年封輔國公。雍正七年卒。）密瓦扎布（三濟扎布長子。雍正八年襲輔國公。乾隆十一年卒。）格埒克（密瓦扎布長子。乾隆十一年襲輔國公。四十三年卒。）車登扎布（格埒克長子。乾隆四十三年襲輔國公。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。嘉慶十六年卒。）巴圖圖魯（車登扎布子。嘉慶十六年襲。）那希哩（巴圖圖魯子。咸豐八年襲。）拉蘇倫（那希哩子。同治十二年襲。）什固爾扎布（光緒十九年襲。）
喀爾喀車臣汗部（扎薩克和碩親王）納木扎勒（車臣汗烏默客叔父。康熙三十年封扎薩克多羅郡王。六十年卒。）達瑪琳多爾濟（納木扎勒長子。康熙六十年襲扎薩克多羅郡王。雍正十年以罪削。）多爾濟扎勒（納木扎勒次子。雍正十年襲扎薩克多羅郡王。乾隆五年卒。）巴雅爾什第（多爾濟扎勒長子。乾隆五年襲扎薩克多羅郡王。二十年，晉和碩親王。四十六年卒。）貢楚克扎布（巴雅爾什第長子。乾隆四十六年襲扎薩克和碩親王，詔世襲罔替。五十五年卒。）達爾瑪錫哩（貢楚克扎布長子。乾隆五十五年襲扎薩克和碩親王。嘉慶十九年卒。）瑪尼巴咱爾（達爾瑪錫哩弟。嘉慶十九年襲。道光五年卒。）車林多爾濟（瑪尼巴咱爾子。道光五年襲。）那木濟勒端多布（車林多爾濟子。咸豐七年襲。光緒二十八年卒。）濟克濟特倫蘇（那木濟勒端多布子。光緒三十年十二月襲。三十三年二月卒。）旺堆多爾濟（宣統元年襲。）
喀爾喀車臣汗部（扎薩克多羅郡王）朋素克（車臣汗烏默客叔父。康熙三十年封扎薩克固山貝子。三十五年，特晉多羅郡王。雍正五年，以老罷。）垂扎布（朋素克長子。雍正五年襲扎薩克多羅郡王。後襲車臣汗，見汗表。）德木楚克（垂扎布長子。雍正十三年襲扎薩克多羅郡王。乾隆四十五年卒。）齊旺多爾濟（德木楚克長子。乾隆四十五年襲扎薩克多羅郡王。四十六年，襲世襲罔替。尋卒。）桑齋多爾濟（齊旺多爾濟長子。乾隆四十六年襲扎薩克多羅郡王。嘉慶元年，襲車臣汗，降郡王爲貝勒，以子瑪哈錫哩襲。五年，襲車臣汗。）巴圖鄂齊爾（桑齋多爾濟長子。嘉慶十六年襲。道光元年卒。）托克托呼圖魯（巴圖鄂齊爾子。道光元年襲。）莽珠巴咱爾（托克托呼圖魯子。同治七年襲。）多爾濟帕喇穆（莽珠巴咱爾子。光緒十年襲。）
喀爾喀車臣汗部（多羅郡王，今襲多羅貝勒）貢格三丕勒（郡王朋素克次子。雍正十一年，以其兄垂扎布襲車臣汗，貢格三丕勒代爲扎薩克多羅郡王。十三年，垂扎布子德穆楚克襲父原爵，詔貢格三丕勒仍爲郡王，不兼扎薩克。乾隆九年卒。）丹津（貢格三丕勒長子。乾隆九年襲多羅貝勒。四十五年卒。）車凌多爾濟（丹津長子。乾隆四十五年襲多羅貝勒。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。嘉慶十二年卒。）索諾穆多爾沁（車凌多爾濟子。嘉慶十二年襲。道光二十二年卒。）幹當當準車林（索諾穆多爾沁子。道光二十二年襲。光緒十七年卒。）札密養吹濟勒蘇倫（光緒十七年二月襲。）
喀爾喀車臣汗部（扎薩克多羅貝勒）車布登（車臣汗烏默客叔父。康熙三十年封扎薩克多羅貝勒。三十三年卒。）旺扎布（車布登長子。康熙三十三年襲扎薩克多羅貝勒。雍正元年，晉多羅郡王。八年，以罪削。九年，復封貝勒。乾隆十四年卒。）旺沁扎布（旺扎布長子。乾隆十四年襲扎薩克多羅貝勒。二十年，擊伊犁叛賊，死之。）達克丹多爾濟（旺沁扎布長子。乾隆二十一年襲扎薩克多羅貝勒。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。嘉慶八年病免。）那木濟勒多爾濟（達克丹多爾濟長子。嘉慶九年襲。道光二十三年卒。）貢楚克扎布（那木濟勒多爾濟子。道光二十三年襲。）貢噶多爾濟（貢楚克扎布子。咸豐七年襲。）車林桑都布（貢噶多爾濟子。咸豐十年襲。光緒三十一年十二月卒。）永端多爾濟（車林桑都布子。光緒三十二年正月襲。）棍布蘇倫（光緒三十四年襲。）
喀爾喀車臣汗部（扎薩克多羅貝勒，今襲固山貝子）布達扎布（車臣汗烏默客從曾祖。康熙三十年封扎薩克固山貝子。五十年，晉多羅貝勒。）雲敦琳沁（布達扎布長子。康熙五十二年降襲扎薩克輔國公。五十五年卒。）巴蘇（雲敦琳沁長子。康熙五十七年襲扎薩克輔國公。乾隆十五年卒。）達爾濟雅（巴蘇長子。乾隆十五年襲扎薩克輔國公。二十年，晉固山貝子。四十五年卒。）索諾木旺扎勒多爾濟（達爾濟雅長子。乾隆四十五年襲扎薩克固山貝子。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。嘉慶七年，以擅殺人，削。）倭多布齊旺（索諾木旺扎勒多爾濟長子。嘉慶八年襲。十五年卒。）彭楚克多爾濟（倭多布齊旺弟。嘉慶十五年襲。道光二十七年卒。）德吉特多爾濟（彭楚克多爾濟子。道光二十七年襲。）貢楚克扎布（德吉特多爾濟子。同治十年襲。）勒旺多爾濟（貢楚克扎布弟。光緒十年襲。二十四年卒。）棍布蘇倫（光緒二十五年四月襲。）

喀爾喀車臣汗部（扎薩克固山貝子，今襲輔國公）車布登（車臣汗烏默客從曾祖。康熙三十年封扎薩克固山貝子。三十四年卒。）阿勒達爾（車布登長子。康熙三十五年襲扎薩克固山貝子。四十一年卒。）車凌布木（阿勒達爾長子。康熙三十五年襲扎薩克鎭國公。五十三年卒。）格埒克巴木丕勒（車凌布木長子。康熙五十三年降襲扎薩克輔國公。乾隆二十年以罪削。二十一年，詔復其爵。二十五年，晉鎭國公。三十三年卒。）袞布扎布（格埒克巴木丕勒長子。康熙三十六年降襲扎薩克輔國公。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。嘉慶十三年卒。）僧格多爾濟（袞布扎布子。嘉慶十三年襲。道光元年卒。）棍布扎布（僧格多爾濟子。道光元年襲。十九年卒。）棍楚克車林（棍布扎布子。道光十九年襲。咸豐五年卒。）成里克多爾濟（棍楚克車林弟。咸豐五年襲。）

喀爾喀扎薩克圖汗部（扎薩克一等台吉）達什朋素克（貝勒博貝從子。乾隆二十二年授扎薩克一等台吉。二十三年以罪削扎薩克，尋詔復之。四十四年卒。）袞布扎布（達什朋素克長子。乾隆四十四年襲扎薩克一等台吉。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。嘉慶元年卒。）濟克莫特車布登（袞布扎布長子。嘉慶元年襲。道光元年卒。）吹光楚克達什（濟克莫特車布登子。道光元年襲。）呢蘭瓦爾（吹光楚克達什子。光緒元年襲。二十四年九月告休。）車丹多爾濟（光緒三十一年正月襲。）

喀爾喀扎薩克圖汗部（扎薩克一等台吉）諾爾布（扎薩克圖汗格埒克延丕勒族弟。初授二等台吉，隸其叔父貝勒策登扎布旗。乾隆二十一年，策登扎布以附叛賊青袞咱卜，罪誅。授諾爾布扎薩克一等台吉，領其衆。三十二年卒。）敦多布多爾濟（諾爾布長子。乾隆三十二年襲扎薩克一等台吉。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。嘉慶十三年卒。）齊松扎布（敦多布多爾濟子。嘉慶十三年襲。二十三年病免。）齊旺扎布（齊松扎布子。嘉慶二十三年襲。咸豐二年卒。）班扎巴扎爾扎布（齊旺扎布子。咸豐二年襲。）那遜布彥濟爾噶勒（班扎巴扎爾扎布子。同治十二年襲。）扎勒青棍布車坦（光緒二十八年襲。）
喀爾喀扎薩克圖汗部（扎薩克厄魯特一等台吉）噶勒丹達爾扎（輝特人。其父羅卜藏自準噶爾來歸，封輔國公。兄巴濟嗣，復叛歸準噶爾。乾隆二十年，噶勒丹達爾扎自準噶爾來降，詔授一等台吉。三十年卒。）拉克沁噶喇（噶勒丹達爾扎長子。乾隆三十年襲一等台吉，授扎薩克，詔隸喀爾喀扎薩克圖汗部。四十六年卒。）薩木丕勒諾爾布（拉克沁噶喇長子。乾隆四十六年襲扎薩克一等台吉。是年，詔世襲罔替。嘉慶十二年卒。）拉旺班珠爾（薩木丕勒諾爾布長子。嘉慶十二年襲。道光三十年）達木丹瓦齋爾（拉旺班珠爾子。道光三十年襲。）車登多爾濟（達木丹瓦齋爾子。同治七年襲。）伊達布濟黨蘇倫扎布（光緒二十六年襲。）
喀爾喀賽因諾顔部（扎薩克和碩親王）善巴（元太祖裔喀爾喀格埒森扎扎賚爾琿台吉之五世孫。康熙三十年封扎薩克多羅郡王。三十五年晉和碩親王。四十六年卒。）達什敦多布（善巴長子。康熙四十六年襲扎薩克和碩親王。雍正四年以老罷。）喇嘛扎布（達什敦多布長子。雍正四年襲扎薩克和碩親王。十年以罪削。）德沁扎布（達什敦多布次子。雍正十一年襲扎薩克和碩親王。乾隆二十七年卒。）諾爾布扎布（德沁扎布長子。初由公品級封固山貝子，別有表。乾隆二十七年襲扎薩克和碩親王。三十一年，詔其六世祖圖蒙肯賽因諾顔號。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。五十一年以病罷。）車登扎布（諾爾布扎布長子。初襲鎭國公，別有表。乾隆五十一年晉襲扎薩克和碩親王兼賽因諾顔。五十七年卒。）額璘沁多爾濟（車登扎布子。乾隆五十八年襲扎薩克和碩親王。嘉慶五年以罪削。）朋楚克達什（額璘沁多爾濟弟。嘉慶七年襲。二十二年病免。）車林多爾濟（朋楚克達什子。嘉慶二十二年襲。咸豐三年卒。）德木吹（車林多爾濟子。咸豐三年襲。）車林端多布（德木吹從弟。同治十年襲。）特固斯瓦齊爾（車林端多布子。光緒九年襲。）那木囊蘇倫（特固斯瓦齊爾子。光緒二十二年襲。）
喀爾喀賽因諾顔部（鎭國公）諾爾布扎布（乾隆十年賜公品級。二十年，封固山貝子。後襲扎薩克和碩親王兼賽因諾顔。見親王表。）車登扎布（諾爾布扎布長子。乾隆二十七年襲鎭國公。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。五十一年，襲扎薩克和碩親王兼賽因諾顔。見親王表。）額璘沁多爾濟（車登扎布長子。乾隆五十一年襲鎭國公。五十八年，襲扎薩克和碩親王。）朋楚克達什（額璘沁多爾濟弟。乾隆五十八年襲鎭國公。嘉慶七年，改襲扎薩克和碩親王。）扎納扎布（朋楚克達什長子。嘉慶八年襲。道光二十九年卒。）車林端多布（扎納扎布子。道光二十九年襲。）特固斯瓦齊爾（車林端多布子。同治十一年襲。）邦當那木濟勒（特固斯瓦齊爾子。光緒十年襲。）那木囊蘇倫（邦當那木濟勒弟。光緒十二年襲。）額琳沁薩什（光緒二十四年二月襲。）
喀爾喀賽因諾顔部（公品級一等台吉）三丕勒多爾濟（親王德沁扎布第三子。初授一等台吉。乾隆二十二年賜公品級。四十九年卒。）達瑪璘（三丕勒多爾濟長子。乾隆五十年襲公品級一等台吉。五十七年卒。）敏珠爾（達瑪璘之弟。乾隆五十七年襲公品級一等台吉。嘉慶十九年卒。子滾布敏珠爾襲一等台吉，銷去公品級。）
喀爾喀賽因諾顔部（扎薩克和碩親王）策稜（親王善巴再從弟。康熙三十一年授三等輕車都尉。四十五年賜貝子品級。六十年授扎薩克。雍正元年特封郡王。九年，晉封和碩親王，授喀爾喀大扎薩克。十年，賜號超勇。乾隆十五年薨，諡襄，配享太廟，入祀賢良祠。）成袞扎布（策稜長子。乾隆元年封固山貝子。四年封世子。十五年襲扎薩克和碩親王。三十六年卒。）拉旺多爾濟（成袞扎布第七子。乾隆二十九年封世子。三十六年襲扎薩克和碩親王。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。嘉慶二十一年卒。）巴彥多爾濟噶勒（拉旺多爾濟嗣子。嘉慶二十一年襲。）車登巴咱爾（巴彥多爾濟噶勒子。嘉慶二十一年襲。咸豐二年卒。）達爾瑪（車登巴咱爾子。咸豐二年襲。）那彥圖（達爾瑪子。同治十三年襲。）

喀爾喀賽因諾顔部（輔國公）額爾克沙喇（親王成袞扎布長子。乾隆二十二年封輔國公。二十三年，賜貝子品級。三十一年卒，貝子品級停襲。）伊什扎木楚（額爾克沙喇弟。乾隆三十一年襲輔國公。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。五十五年卒。）達什多爾濟（伊什扎木楚姪孫。乾隆五十六年襲輔國公。嘉慶元年卒。）呢瑪（達什多爾濟長子。嘉慶二年襲。）布呢達哩（呢瑪長子。道光十一年襲。二十四年卒。）密濟特多爾濟（布呢達哩子。道光二十四年襲。）額克里色莽奈（光緒三十三年三月襲。）
喀爾喀賽因諾顔部（輔國公）佛保（初襲其父貝勒恭格喇布坦爵，見貝勒表。二十二年自伊犁歸，賜公品級。二十八年封輔國公。三十六年卒。）三丕勒敦多克（佛保長子。乾隆三十六年襲輔國公。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。）格哩克敦多布（三丕勒敦多克嗣子。嘉慶七年襲。二十三年卒。）桑都克多爾濟（格哩克敦多布子。嘉慶二十三年襲。道光三十年病免。）濟克濟特瓦齊爾（桑都克多爾濟子。道光三十年襲。）車凌多爾濟（濟克濟特瓦齊爾子。光緒四年襲。）洛布桑吹木伯勒（光緒十九年四月襲。）

喀爾喀賽因諾顔部（扎薩克多羅郡王）車布登扎布（超勇襄親王策稜次子，封輔國公。乾隆十六年授扎薩克。十九年，賜貝子品級。二十年封多羅貝勒。二十一年晉多羅郡王。二十三年，詔繼其父超勇號，賜親王品級。四十五年，以冒請展界，削親王品級。四十六年，詔世襲郡王罔替。四十七年卒。）三丕勒多爾濟（車布登扎布長子。乾隆四十七年襲扎薩克多羅郡王。）達瑪琳扎布（三丕勒多爾濟長子。嘉慶十二年襲。二十年卒。）楚克蘇木扎布（達瑪琳扎布子。嘉慶二十年襲。道光十一年卒。）車凌棍布（楚克蘇木扎布弟。道光十一年襲。十七年卒。）達爾瑪巴札爾（車凌棍布子。道光十七年襲。咸豐四年卒。）桑噶希哩（達爾瑪巴札爾弟。咸豐四年襲。）車凌多爾濟（桑噶希哩子。光緒九年襲。十八年卒。）庫魯固木扎布（車凌多爾濟子。光緒十八年襲。）

喀爾喀賽因諾顔部（扎薩克多羅郡王）托多額爾德尼（親王善巴再從弟。康熙三十年封扎薩克鎭國公。三十一年卒。）烏巴達（托多額爾德尼兄。康熙三十二年襲扎薩克鎭國公。四十九年卒。）巴穆（烏巴達長子。康熙五十年襲扎薩克鎭國公。五十一年卒。）策旺諾爾布（托多額爾德尼嗣子。康熙五十一年襲扎薩克鎭國公。雍正二年，晉固山貝子。十年，以老罷。）車木楚克扎布（策旺諾爾布長子。雍正十年襲扎薩克鎭國公。乾隆三年，晉固山貝子。十九年，賜貝勒品級。二十一年，封多羅貝勒。尋晉多羅郡王。四十三年卒。）貢楚克扎布（車木楚克扎布長子。乾隆四十四年襲扎薩克多羅郡王。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。五十三年以病罷。）德木楚克扎布（貢楚克扎布之弟。乾隆五十三年襲扎薩克多羅郡王。道光十一年卒。）圖克濟扎布（德木楚克扎布子。道光十一年襲。二十九年卒。）推音固爾扎布（圖克濟扎布子。道光二十九年襲。）格勒克扎木楚（推音固爾扎布從父。咸豐七年襲。）吹蘇隆扎布（格勒克扎木楚子。光緒四年襲。三十二年卒。）扎密多爾濟（光緒三十三年襲。）

喀爾喀賽因諾顔部（扎薩克一等台吉）素達尼（親王善巴從弟。康熙三十六年授扎薩克一等台吉。三十九年卒。）薩喇旺扎勒（素達尼長子。康熙三十九年襲扎薩克一等台吉。雍正元年卒。）車布登（薩喇旺扎勒長子。雍正元年襲扎薩克一等台吉。十一年以罪削。）賚充扎布（車布登長子。雍正十一年襲扎薩克一等台吉。乾隆二十四年卒。）納旺車凌（車布登次子。乾隆二十四年襲扎薩克一等台吉。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。四十九年以病罷。）貢格拉什（納旺車凌第四子。乾隆四十九年襲扎薩克一等台吉。嘉慶六年卒。）貢楚克扎布（貢格拉什長子。嘉慶六年襲。道光十九年卒。）占巴拉（貢楚克扎布子。道光十九年襲。二十七年卒。）車登丕勒濟雅（占巴拉從子。道光二十七年襲。）蘊端多爾濟（車登丕勒濟雅子。光緒九年襲。）車林多爾濟（蘊端多爾濟弟。光緒十三年襲。）
喀爾喀賽因諾顔部（公品級三等台吉）噶瓦（扎薩克台吉賚充扎布同族。初授三等台吉。乾隆二十一年，賜公品級。三十四年卒。）桑濟（噶瓦長子。乾隆三十四年襲公品級三等台吉。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。）旺丕勒（桑濟子。嘉慶二十二年襲。）車凌桑魯布（旺丕勒子。道光三年襲。）維多布桑保（車凌桑魯布子。同治三年襲。）
喀爾喀賽因諾顔部（扎薩克一等台吉）濟納彌達（親王善巴再從弟。康熙四十八年授扎薩克一等台吉。雍正二年卒。）特克什（濟納彌達長子。雍正二年襲扎薩克一等台吉。乾隆十五年卒。）烏巴什（特克什長子。乾隆十五年襲扎薩克一等台吉。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。五十三年卒。）布達齊素嚨（烏巴什長子。乾隆五十四年襲扎薩克一等台吉。嘉慶十年卒。）袞布多爾濟（布達齊素嚨弟。嘉慶十年襲。道光二十五年卒。）噶勒桑多爾濟（袞布多爾濟子。道光二十五年襲。咸豐元年卒。）章楚布多爾濟（噶勒桑多爾濟兄。咸豐元年襲。）額林多爾濟（章楚布多爾濟子。咸豐二年襲。）達揚扎勒保（光緒二十三年二月襲。）
喀爾喀賽因諾顔部（扎薩克一等台吉）多爾濟（親王善巴從弟。康熙五十一年授扎薩克一等台吉。雍正三年以病罷。）呢瑪（多爾濟長子。雍正三年襲扎薩克一等台吉。十年卒。）阿保（呢瑪長子。雍正十年襲扎薩克一等台吉。乾隆十八年卒。）車璘巴勒（多爾濟次子。乾隆十八年襲扎薩克一等台吉。二十五年卒。）成袞扎布（車璘巴勒長子。乾隆二十五年襲扎薩克一等台吉。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。五十年卒。）德木楚克（成袞扎布長子。乾隆五十年襲扎薩克一等台吉。嘉慶五年卒。）車登達什（德木楚克弟。嘉慶六年襲。二十五年卒。）桑津扎布（車登達什弟。道光十一年襲。）車林（桑津扎布子。道光十一年襲。十二年卒。）布彥濟爾噶勒（車林之弟。道光十二年襲。）齊默特巴勒津（光緒二十年三月襲。）
喀爾喀賽因諾顔部（扎薩克一等台吉）額墨根（郡王袞布曾孫。乾隆三年授一等台吉，領扎薩克。二十二年卒。）達什（額墨根長子。乾隆二十二年襲扎薩克一等台吉。二十三年，賜公品級。二十五年卒。）班第（達什長子。乾隆二十五年襲扎薩克一等台吉。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。五十五年卒。）達瑪璘（班第長子。乾隆五十五年襲扎薩克一等台吉。嘉慶二十四年卒。）哈思巴咱爾（達瑪璘子。嘉慶二十四年襲。道光十九年卒。）布木達爾（哈思巴咱爾子。道光十九年襲。）齊默特多爾濟（布木達爾子。同治四年襲。）扎木薩林扎布（齊默特多爾濟弟。同治六年襲。）巴爾瓦喇克察（光緒三十一年襲。）
喀爾喀賽因諾顔部（厄魯特扎薩克固山貝子）阿喇布坦（準噶爾台吉額爾墨特達爾漢諾顔之九世孫。康熙四十一年來降，封扎薩克多羅郡王。四十二年卒。）車凌旺布（阿喇布坦長子。康熙四十二年襲扎薩克多羅郡王。雍正六年卒。）色布騰旺布（阿喇布坦次子。雍正元年封多羅貝勒。四年，授扎薩克。七年，襲多羅郡王，幷兩扎薩克爲一。乾隆十三年卒。）朋素克（色布騰旺布嗣子。乾隆十三年降襲扎薩克固山貝子。二十六年，詔隸喀爾喀賽因諾顔部。四十三年以罪削扎薩克，留貝子爵。）納木扎勒（朋素克長子。乾隆四十三年襲扎薩克固山貝子。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。五十三年卒。）車凌多爾濟（納木扎勒長子。乾隆五十三年襲扎薩克固山貝子。五十六年卒。）朋素克（車凌多爾濟之祖。乾隆五十六年，仍襲扎薩克固山貝子。嘉慶三年卒。）多爾濟巴勒（朋素克孫。嘉慶四年襲。二十二年卒。）察克都爾扎勒（多爾濟巴勒從弟。嘉慶二十二年襲。）達克丹多爾濟（察克都爾扎勒子。光緒五年襲。三十年卒。）桑都克多爾濟（光緒三十三年三月襲。）
喀爾喀賽因諾顔部（厄魯特扎薩克固山貝子）丹濟拉（準噶爾台吉額爾墨特達爾漢諾顔之九世孫。康熙三十六年來降，授內大臣。四十四年，封扎薩克輔國公。四十七年卒。）多爾濟色布騰（丹濟拉長子。康熙四十七年襲扎薩克輔國公。雍正元年，晉固山貝子。八年，晉多羅貝勒。乾隆二年卒。）三都布（多爾濟色布騰長子。乾隆二年襲扎薩克固山貝子。二十五年卒。）貢楚克邦（三都布嗣子。乾隆二十六年襲扎薩克固山貝子，詔隸喀爾喀賽因諾顔部。四十六年，詔世襲罔替。）濟克墨特貢桑（貢楚克邦長子。嘉慶九年襲。）車伯克扎勒（濟克墨特貢桑子。嘉慶十三年襲。十九年卒。）扎木彥多爾濟（車伯克扎勒兄。嘉慶十九年襲。二十三年卒。）貢格多爾濟（扎木彥多爾濟從弟。嘉慶二十三年襲。）車都布多爾濟（貢格多爾濟子。道光二十二年襲。）齊莫特德哩克（車都布多爾濟從子。光緒十二年襲。）

Khalkha Tushetu Khan Division — Tushetu Khan lineChaqur Dorji (fifth-generation descendant of the Khalkha taiji Geresenja Zhaqur and an heir of Genghis Khan; succeeded his father Gunbu as khan under the title Tushetu; in Kangxi 30 the court confirmed the Tushetu Khan title; died in Kangxi 38.)Dunbu Dorji (grandson of Chaqur Dorji; first inherited his father's commandery-prince title as Galdan Dorji; in Kangxi 39 was raised to a first-rank prince of the blood and succeeded as Tushetu Khan; later demoted for neglect of duty to his former rank — see the commandery-princes table.)Dorji Erdeni Ahai (second son of Chaqur Dorji; succeeded as Tushetu Khan in Kangxi 41; died in Kangxi 50.)Wangzha Dorji (eldest son of Dorji Erdeni Ahai; succeeded as Tushetu Khan in Kangxi 50; died in Yongzheng 10.)Dundan Dorji (second son of Wangzha Dorji; succeeded as Tushetu Khan in Yongzheng 10; died in Qianlong 8.)Dundob Dorji (fourth son of Wangzha Dorji; succeeded as Tushetu Khan in Qianlong 9; died in Qianlong 10.)Yanpile Dorji (eldest son of Wangzha Dorji; succeeded as Tushetu Khan in Qianlong 11; died in Qianlong 23.)Chedeng Dorji (second son of Dundob Dorji; succeeded as Tushetu Khan in Qianlong 24; in Qianlong 46 received perpetual hereditary tenure; stripped for crime in Qianlong 58.)Minzhur Dorji (eldest son of Chedeng Dorji; succeeded as Tushetu Khan in Qianlong 58; died in Qianlong 59.)Chedeng Dorji (father of Minzhur Dorji; resumed the Tushetu Khan succession in Qianlong 59; died in Jiaqing 21.)Eidob Dorji (son of Chedeng Dorji; succeeded in Jiaqing 20; died in Daoguang 9.)Yalingtai (son of Eidob Dorji; succeeded in Daoguang 9; died in Daoguang 12.)Chelin Dorji (younger brother of Yalingtai; succeeded in Daoguang 12; died in Tongzhi 2.)Nason Choktu (son of Chelin Dorji; succeeded in Tongzhi 2; died in Guangxu 26.)Senangyile Dorji (son of Nason Choktu; succeeded in Guangxu 26; died in Guangxu 29.)Dash Nima (adopted son of Senangyile Dorji; succeeded in Guangxu 30.)
Khalkha Tushetu Khan Division — jasak Prince of the Commandery (second rank)Gulushi (younger kinsman of Chaqur Dorji; enfeoffed as jasak Prince of the Commandery in Kangxi 30; died in Kangxi 44.)Dorji Alabutan (eldest son of Gulushi; succeeded as jasak Prince of the Commandery in Kangxi 44; removed for illness in Yongzheng 6.)Minzhur Dorji (eldest son of Dorji Alabutan; succeeded as jasak Prince of the Commandery in Yongzheng 6; died in Qianlong 5.)Cheling Baidubu (eldest son of Minzhur Dorji; succeeded as jasak Prince of the Commandery in Qianlong 5; killed fighting Ili rebels in Qianlong 20.)Danzhong Dorji (eldest son of Cheling Baidubu; succeeded as jasak Prince of the Commandery in Qianlong 20; died in Qianlong 37.)Chibak Zhab (second son of Cheling Baidubu; succeeded as jasak Prince of the Commandery in Qianlong 37; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Qianlong 47.)Dorji Zhab (eldest son of Chibak Zhab; succeeded as jasak Prince of the Commandery in Qianlong 47.)Dakdan Dorji (son of Dorji Zhab; succeeded in Jiaqing 23; died in Daoguang 7.)Lasulong Bazhar (son of Dakdan Dorji; succeeded in Daoguang 7.)Amugha Bazhar (son of Lasulong Bazhar; succeeded in Guangxu 1.)Anang Dawa Zhier (succeeded in the fourth month of Guangxu 18.)
Khalkha Tushetu Khan Division — jasak Prince of the Third RankGaldan Dorji (eldest son of Tushetu Khan Chaqur Dorji; enfeoffed as jasak Prince of the Commandery in Kangxi 30; died in Kangxi 31.)Dunbu Dorji (eldest son of Galdan Dorji; succeeded as jasak Prince of the Commandery in Kangxi 31; in Kangxi 39 was raised to a first-rank prince of the blood and became Tushetu Khan — see the khans' table; demoted to his former commandery rank in Kangxi 41; re-enfeoffed as prince of the blood in Yongzheng 1; died in Qianlong 8.)Elinqin Dorji (second son of Dunbu Dorji; succeeded as jasak Prince of the Commandery in Qianlong 8; executed and stripped of rank for crime in Qianlong 20.)Genzhab Dorji (eldest son of Dunbu Dorji; demoted to succeed as jasak Prince of the Third Rank in Qianlong 22; died in Qianlong 25.)Gezhai Dorji (third son of Dunbu Dorji; succeeded as jasak with ducal rank in Qianlong 25; removed for illness in Qianlong 36.)Chebudeng Dorji (second son of Gezhai Dorji; succeeded as jasak Prince of the Third Rank in Qianlong 25; assumed the jasak post in Qianlong 36; died in Qianlong 39.)Xundob Dorji (eldest son of Chebudeng Dorji; succeeded as jasak Prince of the Third Rank in Qianlong 39; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Jiaqing 3.)Ningbao Dorji (eldest son of Xundob Dorji; succeeded in Jiaqing 4; died in Daoguang 12.)Deleke Dorji (son of Ningbao Dorji; succeeded in Daoguang 12.)Namjile Duandob (son of Deleke Dorji; succeeded in Tongzhi 7.)Bengchuke Chelin (son of Namjile Duandob; succeeded in Guangxu 10.)
Khalkha Tushetu Khan Division — jasak Prince of the Blood (first rank)Chemuchuke Namuzhale (nephew of Tushetu Khan Chaqur Dorji; granted first-class jasak taiji in Kangxi 30; enfeoffed as Duke Who Assists the State in Kangxi 35; specially promoted to second-rank prince of the blood in Yongzheng 1; died in Yongzheng 10; posthumously raised to commandery prince in Qianlong 3.)Chenggun Zhab (eldest son of Chemuchuke Namuzhale; succeeded as jasak second-rank prince of the blood in Yongzheng 10; promoted to commandery prince in Qianlong 3; died in Qianlong 11.)Chibak Yalamu Pile (eldest son of Chenggun Zhab; succeeded as jasak commandery prince in Qianlong 12; raised to first-rank prince of the blood in Qianlong 21; died in Qianlong 42.)Chibak Dorji (second son of Chibak Yalamu Pile; succeeded as jasak first-rank prince of the blood in Qianlong 42; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Jiaqing 2.)Chibak Zhab (nephew of Chibak Dorji; succeeded in Jiaqing 2; died in Jiaqing 6.)Chebudeng Dorji (son of Chibak Zhab; succeeded in Jiaqing 6; died in Daoguang 18.)Elinqin Dorji (son of Chebudeng Dorji; succeeded in Daoguang 18; removed for illness in Xianfeng 4.)Chelin Dorji (son of Elinqin Dorji; succeeded in Xianfeng 4; died in Guangxu 18.)Hangda Dorji (grandson of Chelin Dorji; succeeded in the fifth month of Guangxu 18.)
Khalkha Tushetu Khan Division — first-class taiji with ducal rankSanji Zhab (eldest son of Prince Chibak Yalamu Pile; first granted first-class taiji; died in Qianlong 22 and was posthumously given ducal rank.)Sandob Dorji (eldest son of Sanji Zhab; succeeded as first-class taiji with ducal rank in Qianlong 22; died in Jiaqing 15.)Gunchuke Dash (son of Sandob Dorji; succeeded in Jiaqing 15.)
Khalkha Tushetu Khan Division — jasak Prince of the Blood (first rank)Xidishili (younger brother of Tushetu Khan Chaqur Dorji; enfeoffed as jasak second-rank prince of the blood in Kangxi 30; died in Kangxi 45.)Danjin Dorji (second son of Xidishili; succeeded as jasak second-rank prince of the blood in Kangxi 45; enfeoffed as commandery prince in Yongzheng 1; raised to first-rank prince of the blood in Yongzheng 8; demoted to commandery prince for crime in Yongzheng 11; restored as prince of the blood in Qianlong 1; died in Qianlong 3.)Sangzhai Dorji (grandson of Danjin Dorji; succeeded as jasak commandery prince in Qianlong 3; raised to first-rank prince of the blood in Qianlong 20; stripped for crime in Qianlong 30, then restored to commandery prince by edict; died in Qianlong 43.)Yundan Dorji (eldest son of Sangzhai Dorji; succeeded as jasak commandery prince in Qianlong 44; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Daoguang 7.)Dorji Labutan (son of Yundan Dorji; succeeded in Daoguang 8; died in Daoguang 19.)Nason Batu (son of Dorji Labutan; succeeded in Daoguang 19; died in Daoguang 30.)Ete Sar Bazhar (son of Nason Batu; succeeded in Daoguang 30; retired in the eleventh month of Guangxu 21.)Chelin Balin (son of Ete Sar Bazhar; succeeded in the eleventh month of Guangxu 21.)
Khalkha Tushetu Khan Division — jasak first-class taijiXibutui Hatan Batu'er (younger cousin of Tushetu Khan Chaqur Dorji; enfeoffed as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Kangxi 30; promoted to third-rank prince in Kangxi 38; died in Kangxi 43.)Chebudeng (second son of Xibutui Hatan Batu'er; demoted to jasak Duke Who Guards the State in Kangxi 45; raised to second-rank prince of the blood in Yongzheng 1 and to commandery prince in Yongzheng 10; stripped and demoted to second-rank prince in Yongzheng 11; demoted to third-rank prince in Qianlong 19 but restored to second-rank prince by edict; stripped for siding with the rebel Qinggun Zhab in Qianlong 21.)Qiwang Dorji (eldest son of Chebudeng; resumed as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 21; died in Qianlong 30.)Chebudeng (granted ducal rank in Qianlong 23; resumed as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 30; died in Qianlong 35.)Qisuolong Dorji (grandson of Chebudeng; demoted to jasak first-class taiji in Qianlong 35; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Jiaqing 5.)Yitamu Zhab (eldest son of Qisuolong Dorji; succeeded in Jiaqing 5; died in Jiaqing 20.)Chelin Dorji (son of Yitamu Zhab; succeeded in Jiaqing 20.)Cheling Dorji (son of Chelin Dorji; succeeded in Tongzhi 10.)Nason Gumub (son of Cheling Dorji; succeeded in Guangxu 12.)Sotenamu Daerjiya (succeeded in Xuantong 1.)
Khalkha Tushetu Khan Division — jasak Duke Who Assists the StateCheling Bale (fourth son of Tushetu Khan Chaqur Dorji; enfeoffed as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Kangxi 50; died in Yongzheng 6.)Bamupile Dorji (eldest son of Cheling Bale; succeeded as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Yongzheng 7; died in Qianlong 12.)Chedeng Sanpile (second son of Bamupile Dorji; succeeded as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 13; died in Qianlong 41.)Lasuolong Dorji (eldest son of Chedeng Sanpile; succeeded as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 42; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46.)Chelin Zhab (son of Lasuolong Dorji; succeeded in Jiaqing 19; died in Daoguang 5.)Labudan Dorji (son of Chelin Zhab; succeeded in Daoguang 5.)Bilike Tai Dorji (younger brother of Labudan Dorji; succeeded in Xianfeng 11.)Mishike Dorji (son of Bilike Tai Dorji; succeeded in Guangxu 1; reported retirement in the third month of Guangxu 22.)Edar Tok Chibuyang Wazhier (son of Mishike Dorji; succeeded in Guangxu 22.)
Khalkha Tushetu Khan Division — jasak Duke Who Assists the StateBahai (eldest son of Prince of the Third Rank Xibutui Hatan Batu'er; granted first-class jasak taiji in Yongzheng 9; enfeoffed as Duke Who Assists the State in Yongzheng 10; died in Qianlong 8.)Gunchuke Zhab (eldest son of Bahai; succeeded as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 8; died in Qianlong 28.)Gunchuke Dash (eldest son of Gunchuke Zhab; succeeded as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 28; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Qianlong 49.)Baledar Zhab (younger brother of Gunchuke Dash; succeeded as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 49; died in Jiaqing 1.)Wodob Qiwang (eldest son of Baledar Zhab; succeeded in Jiaqing 1; died in Daoguang 3.)Sandob Mingzhu'er (son of Wodob Qiwang; succeeded in Daoguang 3; died in Daoguang 11.)Dash Dorji (son of Sandob Mingzhu'er; succeeded in Daoguang 11.)Mandarwa (son of Dash Dorji; succeeded in Tongzhi 4.)Sazaiwa'er (succeeded in the third month of Guangxu 34.)

Khalkha Chechen Khan Division — Chechen Khan lineWumoke (descendant of Yuan Taizu; seventh-generation descendant of Khalkha Gegen Senza Zha Zhagür Kh taiji; succeeded his father Ileden Alabutan as khan under the title Chechen; the Chechen Khan title was retained by edict in Kangxi 30; died in Kangxi 48.)Gunchen (eldest son of Wumoke; succeeded as Chechen Khan in Kangxi 48; died in Yongzheng 6.)Chedeng Banzhu'er (eldest son of Gunchen; succeeded as Chechen Khan in Yongzheng 6; stripped for dereliction of duty in Yongzheng 11.)Chuizhab (younger cousin of Wumoke; first succeeded to his father Commandery Prince Punsuk's title, see commandery prince table; succeeded as Chechen Khan in Yongzheng 11; died in Yongzheng 13.)Damalin (second son of Gunchen; succeeded as Chechen Khan in Yongzheng 13; died in Qianlong 16.)Mani Badara (eldest son of Damalin; succeeded as Chechen Khan in Qianlong 16; died in Qianlong 32.)Chedeng Zhab (second son of Damalin; succeeded as Chechen Khan in Qianlong 32; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Qianlong 53.)Qiwang Dorji (eldest son of Chedeng Zhab; succeeded as Chechen Khan in Qianlong 53; died in Qianlong 60.)Pengchuk Dorji (second son of Qiwang Dorji; succeeded in Qianlong 60; died the same year.)Sangzhai Dorji (eldest son of Qiwang Dorji; succeeded in Jiaqing 1; demoted to fourth-class taiji in Jiaqing 5.)Mahashili (adopted son of Pengchuk Dorji; succeeded in Jiaqing 5; died in Jiaqing 12.)Enketulu (eldest son of Mahashili; succeeded in Jiaqing 12; removed for illness in Jiaqing 22.)Altashda (son of Enketulu; succeeded in Jiaqing 22.)Chelin Dorji (son of Altashda; succeeded in Guangxu 1; died in Guangxu 19.)Demuchuk Dorji (succeeded in Guangxu 19; died in Xuantong 1.)Akwang Nalin (succeeded in Xuantong 1.)

Khalkha Zasaktu Khan Division — originally enfeoffed Zasaktu Khan and first-rank prince of the blood lineCewang Zhab (seventh-generation descendant of the Khalkha taiji Geresenja Zhaqur and an heir of Genghis Khan; his great-grandfather Subadi styled himself khan under the title Zasaktu; enfeoffed as jasak first-rank prince of the blood in Kangxi 30; granted perpetual Zasaktu Khan succession in Kangxi 42; stripped for crime in Yongzheng 10, after which his clansman Geleke Yanpile succeeded to the khan title by edict — see separate table.)
Khalkha Zasaktu Khan Division — Zasaktu Khan with concurrent commandery-prince rankPengsuke Labutan (sixth-generation descendant of the Khalkha taiji Geresenja Zhaqur; enfeoffed as jasak commandery prince in Kangxi 30; died in Kangxi 51.)Geleke Yanpile (eldest son of Pengsuke Labutan; succeeded as jasak commandery prince in Kangxi 51; became Zasaktu Khan in Yongzheng 10 while retaining the commandery-prince rank; died in Qianlong 6.)Baledar (eldest son of Geleke Yanpile; succeeded as jasak commandery prince in Qianlong 6 and as Zasaktu Khan in Qianlong 7; died in Qianlong 35.)Qiwang Balezhai (eldest son of Baledar; succeeded as jasak commandery prince in Qianlong 35; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; removed for illness in Qianlong 56.)Bunilaina (eldest son of Qiwang Balezhai; succeeded as jasak commandery prince in Qianlong 56; died in Daoguang 3.)Manibazhan'er (son of Bunilaina; succeeded in Daoguang 3; died in Daoguang 20.)Chelin Duandob (son of Manibazhan'er; succeeded in Daoguang 20.)Dorji Palama (son of Chelin Duandob; succeeded in Guangxu 3; retired in Guangxu 24.)Sotemu Namutan (son of Dorji Palama; succeeded in the twelfth month of Guangxu 24.)

Khalkha Zasaktu Khan Division — jasak second-rank prince of the blood with commandery-prince rankGenden (clan ancestor of Zasaktu Khan Geleke Yanpile; enfeoffed as jasak second-rank prince of the blood in Kangxi 33; died in Kangxi 36.)Songjin Sengge (eldest son of Genden; demoted to succeed as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Kangxi 36; died in Kangxi 43.)Bobe (heir son of Songjin Sengge; demoted to first-class jasak taiji in Kangxi 43; succeeded as Duke Who Assists the State in Kangxi 44; specially enfeoffed as second-rank prince of the blood for meritorious service in Yongzheng 1; died in Yongzheng 8.)Bandi (eldest son of Bobe; succeeded as jasak second-rank prince of the blood in Yongzheng 8; died in Qianlong 2; his son Qinggun Zhab succeeded but was executed for rebellion in Qianlong 21 and is therefore omitted from the table.)Wangbu Dorji (heir son of Bobe and son of jasak Duke Who Assists the State Elinqin; first inherited his father's rank; succeeded as jasak second-rank prince of the blood in Qianlong 21; granted commandery-prince rank in Qianlong 22.)Cheduob (eldest son of Wangbu Dorji; succeeded as jasak second-rank prince of the blood with commandery-prince rank in Qianlong 22; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Qianlong 50.)Chengdun Zhab (eldest son of Cheduob; succeeded as jasak second-rank prince of the blood with commandery-prince rank in Qianlong 50; died in Jiaqing 19.)Manda'erwa'er (son of Chengdun Zhab; succeeded in Jiaqing 9 with commandery-prince rank; died in Xianfeng 4.)Dobqin Zhamuchu (son of Manda'erwa'er; succeeded in Xianfeng 4 with commandery-prince rank.)A'erdasagala (son of Dobqin Zhamuchu; succeeded in Guangxu 11 with commandery-prince rank.)Namukai Zhangchan (succeeded in Xuantong 1.)

Khalkha Zasaktu Khan Division — jasak Duke Who Assists the StateBobe (younger uncle of Zasaktu Khan Geleke Yanpile; enfeoffed as jasak third-rank prince in Kangxi 30; died in Kangxi 42.)Ubashi (eldest son of Bobe; demoted to succeed as jasak Duke Who Guards the State in Kangxi 42; stripped for crime in Yongzheng 2.)Wangshuke (second son of Bobe; succeeded as jasak Duke Who Guards the State in Yongzheng 2; removed for illness in Qianlong 31.)Lawang Dorji (eldest son of Wangshuke; demoted to succeed as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 31; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; removed for illness in Qianlong 49.)Dabula Chelin (eldest son of Lawang Dorji; succeeded as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 49; died in Daoguang 6.)Wangdan Dorji (son of Dabula Chelin; succeeded in Daoguang 6; died in Daoguang 29.)Jikemite Dorji (son of Wangdan Dorji; succeeded in Daoguang 29.)Gunbusu (succeeded in the second month of Guangxu 24.)
Khalkha Zasaktu Khan Division — jasak Duke Who Assists the StateSonamu Yisi Zhab (younger cousin of jasak commandery prince Pengsuke Labutan; granted first-class jasak taiji in Kangxi 30; enfeoffed as Duke Who Assists the State in Kangxi 36; died in Kangxi 56.)Galsang Sewang (eldest son of Sonamu Yisi Zhab; succeeded as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Kangxi 57; died in Qianlong 2.)Jingzhun Dorji (eldest son of Galsang Sewang; succeeded as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 2; died in Qianlong 23.)Laqin Suolong (eldest son of Jingzhun Dorji; succeeded as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 23; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Jiaqing 9.)Wangshuke (eldest son of Laqin Suolong; succeeded in Jiaqing 7.)Minzhur Dorji (eldest son of Wangshuke; succeeded in Jiaqing 9; died in Daoguang 6.)Sangdob Dorji (son of Minzhur Dorji; succeeded in Daoguang 6; died in Daoguang 22.)Chedeng Duandob Dorji (son of Sangdob Dorji; succeeded in Daoguang 22.)Zhaqai Qing Dalai Namjile Akwang Dorji (succeeded in Xuantong 2.)
Khalkha Zasaktu Khan Division — jasak Duke Who Assists the StateGunzhan (younger uncle of jasak commandery prince Pengsuke Labutan; granted first-class jasak taiji in Kangxi 30; enfeoffed as Duke Who Assists the State in Kangxi 50; died in Kangxi 52.)Minzhur (second son of Gunzhan; succeeded as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Kangxi 52; died in Qianlong 5.)Celubu (eldest son of Minzhur; succeeded as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 5; died in Qianlong 9.)Duoyue'te Dorji (third son of Minzhur; succeeded as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 9; died in Qianlong 21.)Minpimu Dorji (fourth son of Minzhur; succeeded as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 21; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46 and died that same year.)Qiwang Dashi (eldest son of Minpimu Dorji; succeeded as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 46; died in Daoguang 14.)Sadaba Zha'er (son of Qiwang Dashi; succeeded in Daoguang 14.)Luobusang Duandob (son of Sadaba Zha'er; succeeded in Guangxu 2; retired in the seventh month of Guangxu 24.)Gunchuk Dan (succeeded in Guangxu 24.)
Khalkha Zasaktu Khan Division — jasak Duke Who Assists the StateTongmuke (clan uncle of Zasaktu Khan Geleke Yanpile; granted first-class jasak taiji in Kangxi 53; enfeoffed as Duke Who Assists the State in Yongzheng 2; died in Qianlong 4.)Wangqin Zhab (eldest son of Tongmuke; succeeded as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 4; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Qianlong 50.)Gelike (second son of Wangqin Zhab; succeeded as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 50; died in Jiaqing 9.)Chedeng Dorji (heir son of Gelike; succeeded in Jiaqing 9; died in Jiaqing 16.)Sonamu Chelin (son of Chedeng Dorji; succeeded in Jiaqing 16; died in Xianfeng 4.)Dash Labutan (son of Sonamu Chelin; succeeded in Xianfeng 4; died in Guangxu 28.)Zhaleqing Gunbu Dorji (succeeded in the twelfth month of Guangxu 28.)
Khalkha Zasaktu Khan Division — Duke Who Assists the StateCheleke (uncle of Duke Who Assists the State Tongmuke; initially granted first-class taiji; posthumously enfeoffed as Duke Who Assists the State in Yongzheng 10 for dying in battle against the Dzungars, with perpetual hereditary tenure granted by edict.)Mishike (eldest son of Cheleke; succeeded as Duke Who Assists the State in Yongzheng 10; died in Qianlong 29.)Gunchuke Zhab (eldest son of Mishike; succeeded as Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 29; died in Qianlong 40.)Sonamu Chelin (eldest son of Gunchuke Zhab; succeeded as Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 40; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Jiaqing 11.)Dang Suolong (elder brother of Sonamu Chelin; succeeded in Jiaqing 11; died in Daoguang 24.)Dalami Jite (son of Dang Suolong; succeeded in Daoguang 24.)Tub Dorji (son of Dalami Jite; succeeded in Tongzhi 11.)Zhaleqin Zhab (succeeded in the twelfth month of Guangxu 28.)
Khalkha Zasaktu Khan Division — jasak Duke Who Assists the StateShakezha (younger brother of Prince of the Blood Bobe; enfeoffed as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Yongzheng 2; removed for illness in Qianlong 2.)Dorji Chedeng (eldest son of Shakezha; succeeded as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 2; died in Qianlong 29.)Cheduob Dorji (eldest son of Dorji Chedeng; succeeded as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 29; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46.)Shakedor Zhab (eldest son of Cheduob Dorji; succeeded in Jiaqing 8; removed for illness in Daoguang 28.)Dorji Zhab (son of Shakedor Zhab; succeeded in Daoguang 18.)Tegusidelege'er (son of Dorji Zhab; succeeded in Tongzhi 11.)Banzar Laca (succeeded in the second month of Guangxu 14.)
Khalkha Zasaktu Khan Division — jasak Duke Who Assists the StateQibake Zhab (grandnephew of Prince of the Blood Bobe; initially granted second-class taiji; posthumously enfeoffed as Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 21 for dying in battle on the Urianghai campaign, with an edict ordering worship at the Shrine of Loyalty and Devotion.)Batu Jiergale (eldest son of Qibake Zhab; succeeded as Duke Who Assists the State and received jasak rank in Qianlong 22; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Qianlong 60.)Chuisulun (eldest son of Batu Jiergale; succeeded in Qianlong 60; died in Jiaqing 12.)Zhamubala (eldest son of Chuisulun; succeeded in Jiaqing 12; died in Xianfeng 4.)Gongge Dorji (son of Zhamubala; succeeded in Xianfeng 4.)Bayan Jiergale (grandson of Gongge Dorji; succeeded in Guangxu 5.)
Khalkha Zasaktu Khan Division — jasak Duke Who Guards the StateLabutan (second son of Prince of the Blood Zhuoteba; granted first-class jasak taiji in Yongzheng 6; stripped for crime in Yongzheng 10; rank restored by edict in Yongzheng 13; granted ducal rank in Qianlong 21; removed for old age in Qianlong 31.)Sonamu Dorji (grandson of Labutan; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji with ducal rank in Qianlong 31; when his father Langgun Zhab — separately enfeoffed as Duke Who Guards the State for military merit — died that year, an edict had Sonamu Dorji advance to that rank; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Jiaqing 23.)Yun Duan Dashi (son of Sonamu Dorji; succeeded in Jiaqing 23.)Galsang Duandob (son of Yun Duan Dashi; succeeded in Daoguang 12.)Mifamu Sanbu (younger uncle of Galsang Duandob; succeeded in Tongzhi 3.)Damudang Sulun (son of Mifamu Sanbu; succeeded in Guangxu 12.)
Khalkha Zasaktu Khan Division — first-class jasak taijiE'erdini Gunbu (nephew of Prince of the Blood Zhuoteba; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Kangxi 30; died in Kangxi 38.)Chuizhab (eldest son of E'erdini Gunbu; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Kangxi 38; died in Yongzheng 3.)Danjin (eldest son of Chuizhab; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Yongzheng 3; died in Yongzheng 8.)Geleke (second son of Danjin; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Yongzheng 8; stripped for crime in Yongzheng 10.)Luobuzang Labutan (eldest son of Danjin; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Yongzheng 12; stripped for crime in Qianlong 22.)Mangsu'er (eldest son of Luobuzang Labutan; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 22; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Qianlong 54.)Chuimupile (eldest son of Mangsu'er; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 54; died in Daoguang 11.)Yun Duan Dorji (son of Chuimupile; succeeded in Daoguang 11; died in Daoguang 12.)Mangjibazhan'er (son of Yun Duan Dorji; succeeded in Daoguang 12.)Sonamu Chelin (son of Mangjibazhan'er; succeeded in Xianfeng 6.)Bazha'erbani (succeeded in Guangxu 15.)
Khalkha Zasaktu Khan Division — first-class jasak taijiWu'erzhan (great-granduncle of Zasaktu Khan Geleke Yanpile; granted first-class jasak taiji in Kangxi 30; removed for illness in Yongzheng 5.)Miyu'te Dorji (eldest son of Wu'erzhan; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Yongzheng 5; died in Qianlong 13.)Genden Chelin (eldest son of Miyu'te Dorji; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 13; died in Qianlong 35.)Ubashi (eldest son of Genden Chelin; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 35; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Qianlong 51.)Chuizhong Dashi (eldest son of Ubashi; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 51; died in Qianlong 59.)Menggun Zhab (eldest son of Chuizhong Dashi; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 59; died in Jiaqing 14.)Chelin Dorji (son of Menggun Zhab; succeeded in Jiaqing 14; died in Daoguang 25.)Sangqing Qisulong (son of Chelin Dorji; died in Daoguang 25.)Chelin Dorji (son of Sangqing Qisulong; succeeded in Guangxu 6.)Chelin Gunbu (succeeded in Guangxu 9.)
Khalkha Zasaktu Khan Division — Duke Who Assists the StateGunbu Zhab (younger cousin of jasak taiji Wu'erzhan; enfeoffed as Duke Who Assists the State in Yongzheng 2; died soon after.)Shakedu'er Zhab (eldest son of Gunbu Zhab; succeeded as Duke Who Assists the State in Yongzheng 2.)Balesang (second son of Gunbu Zhab; succeeded as Duke Who Assists the State in Yongzheng 8; died in Qianlong 36.)Xilabu Dorji (eldest son of Balesang; succeeded as Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 36; died in Qianlong 42.)Namuzhale Dorji (second son of Xilabu Dorji; succeeded as Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 42; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Daoguang 12.)Hasi Chelin (son of Namuzhale Dorji; succeeded in Daoguang 12.)Gunchuke Zhab (son of Hasi Chelin; succeeded in Xianfeng 9; retired in Guangxu 21.)Dash Chelin (son of Gunchuke Zhab; succeeded in the twelfth month of Guangxu 21.)
Khalkha Zasaktu Khan Division — first-class jasak taijiHamar Daiqing (younger cousin of jasak commandery prince Pengsuke Labutan; granted first-class jasak taiji in Kangxi 36; died in Kangxi 53.)Emubuqi (eldest son of Hamar Daiqing; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Kangxi 53; removed for illness in Qianlong 15.)Da'erbatu (eldest son of Emubuqi; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 15; removed for illness in Qianlong 35.)Dash Linqin (eldest son of Da'erbatu; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 35; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Jiaqing 19.)Danba Dorji (son of Dash Linqin; succeeded in Jiaqing 19; died in Jiaqing 24.)Dulamuzhab (son of Danba Dorji; succeeded in Jiaqing 24; died in Xianfeng 1.)Dakedan Dorji (younger brother of Dulamuzhab; succeeded in Xianfeng 1.)Mamidala (nephew of Dakedan Dorji; succeeded in Tongzhi 11.)Tub Dorji (succeeded in Guangxu 25.)
Khalkha Zasaktu Khan Division — first-class jasak taijiNamaling Zangbu (nephew of Prince of the Blood Bobe; granted first-class jasak taiji in Kangxi 48; died in Kangxi 57.)Zhamuyang (younger brother of Namaling Zangbu; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Kangxi 57; died in Yongzheng 2.)Gunbu Chelin (uncle of Namaling Zangbu; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Yongzheng 2; slain by Dzungar rebels in Yongzheng 10.)Lali (elder brother of Gunbu Chelin; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Yongzheng 10; died in Qianlong 2.)Bandi (eldest son of Lali; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 2; died in Qianlong 21.)Sandob Dorji (eldest son of Bandi; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 21; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Qianlong 60.)Qisu Suolong Dorji (eldest son of Sandob Dorji; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 60; died in Jiaqing 13.)Ga'erdan Gundob (son of Qisu Suolong Dorji; succeeded in Jiaqing 13; died in Daoguang 27.)Maksu'er Zhab (son of Ga'erdan Gundob; succeeded in Daoguang 27.)Zhakeda Sanbale (son of Maksu'er Zhab; succeeded in Tongzhi 3.)Damudan Genbisha (succeeded in Guangxu 21.)
Khalkha Zasaktu Khan Division — first-class jasak taijiYidamuzhab (eldest son of Duke Who Assists the State Gunzhan; granted first-class jasak taiji in Yongzheng 4; died in Qianlong 7.)Genden (third son of Yidamuzhab; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 7; died in Qianlong 28.)Cheduob Dorji (eldest son of Genden; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 28; died in Qianlong 38.)Batur (second son of Cheduob Dorji; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 38; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Daoguang 7.)Elinqin Pile (grandson of Batur; succeeded in Daoguang 7.)Akwang Chelin (son of Elinqin Pile; succeeded in Guangxu 5.)
Khalkha Zasaktu Khan Division — first-class jasak taijiDash Pengsuke (nephew of Prince of the Blood Bobe; granted first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 22; stripped of jasak rank for crime in Qianlong 23 but soon restored by edict; died in Qianlong 44.)Gunbu Zhab (eldest son of Dash Pengsuke; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 44; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Jiaqing 1.)Jikemote Chebudeng (eldest son of Gunbu Zhab; succeeded in Jiaqing 1; died in Daoguang 1.)Chuiguang Chuke Dashi (son of Jikemote Chebudeng; succeeded in Daoguang 1.)Nilaniwa'er (son of Chuiguang Chuke Dashi; succeeded in Guangxu 1; retired in the ninth month of Guangxu 24.)Chedan Dorji (succeeded in the first month of Guangxu 31.)
Khalkha Zasaktu Khan Division — first-class jasak taijiPuerpu Chelin (nephew of Duke Who Assists the State Tongmuke; came from the Dzungars to submit in Qianlong 20 and was granted first-class jasak taiji; died in Qianlong 24.)Shakedu'er Zhab (heir son of Puerpu Chelin; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 24; died in Qianlong 29.)Nimubu Dorji (also heir son of Puerpu Chelin; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 29; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; stripped for crime in Qianlong 49.)Gunchuke (younger uncle of Nimubu Dorji; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 50; died in Qianlong 58.)Nima (nephew of Nimubu Dorji; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 59; died in Jiaqing 13.)Ta'erbahi (son of Nima; succeeded in Jiaqing 13; died in Jiaqing 25.)Norbuzhale (son of Ta'erbahi; succeeded in Jiaqing 25; died in Daoguang 28.)Engkedeleke Lenggui (son of Norbuzhale; succeeded in Daoguang 28.)Yun Duan Dorji (son of Engkedeleke Lenggui; succeeded in Guangxu 1; retired in the eighth month of Guangxu 24.)Manibazha'er (succeeded in the eleventh month of Guangxu 25.)
Khalkha Zasaktu Khan Division — first-class jasak taijiNorbu (clansman younger brother of Zasaktu Khan Geleke Yanpile; initially granted second-class taiji under his uncle Prince of the Blood Cedeng Zhab; when Cedeng Zhab was executed in Qianlong 21 for siding with the rebel Qinggun Zhab, Norbu was granted first-class jasak taiji and given his following; died in Qianlong 32.)Dundob Dorji (eldest son of Norbu; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 32; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Jiaqing 13.)Qisong Zhab (son of Dundob Dorji; succeeded in Jiaqing 13; removed for illness in Jiaqing 23.)Qiwang Zhab (son of Qisong Zhab; succeeded in Jiaqing 23; died in Xianfeng 2.)Banzhabazha'er Zhab (son of Qiwang Zhab; succeeded in Xianfeng 2.)Naxunbu Yan Jiergale (son of Banzhabazha'er Zhab; succeeded in Tongzhi 12.)Zhaleqing Gunbu Chetan (succeeded in Guangxu 28.)
Khalkha Zasaktu Khan Division — Oirat first-class jasak taijiGaledan Darja (a Khuwet; his father Luobuzang submitted from the Dzungars and was enfeoffed as Duke Who Assists the State; his elder brother Baji succeeded but later rebelled and returned to the Dzungars; Galedan Darja surrendered from the Dzungars in Qianlong 20 and was granted first-class taiji by edict; died in Qianlong 30.)Laqcin Gara (eldest son of Galedan Darja; succeeded as first-class taiji in Qianlong 30, was granted jasak, and by edict was placed under the Khalkha Zasaktu Khan Division; died in Qianlong 46.)Sambuile Norbu (eldest son of Laqcin Gara; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 46; granted perpetual hereditary tenure that same year; died in Jiaqing 12.)Lawang Banshur (eldest son of Sambuile Norbu; succeeded in Jiaqing 12; Daoguang 30.)Damudan Wazhier (son of Lawang Banshur; succeeded in Daoguang 30.)Chedeng Dorji (son of Damudan Wazhier; succeeded in Tongzhi 7.)Yidabuji Dangsulun Zhab (succeeded in Guangxu 26.)
Khalkha Sayin Noyan Division — jasak Prince of the Blood of the First RankShanba (fifth-generation descendant of the Khalkha taiji Geresenja Zhaqur and an heir of Genghis Khan; enfeoffed as jasak commandery prince in Kangxi 30; promoted to first-rank prince of the blood in Kangxi 35; died in Kangxi 46.)Dashidun Duobu (eldest son of Shanba; succeeded as jasak first-rank prince of the blood in Kangxi 46; removed for old age in Yongzheng 4.)Lama Zhab (eldest son of Dashidun Duobu; succeeded as jasak first-rank prince of the blood in Yongzheng 4; stripped for crime in Yongzheng 10.)Deqin Zhab (second son of Dashidun Duobu; succeeded as jasak first-rank prince of the blood in Yongzheng 11; died in Qianlong 27.)Norbu Zhab (eldest son of Deqin Zhab; first enfeoffed as Prince of the Third Rank from ducal rank — see separate table; succeeded as jasak first-rank prince of the blood in Qianlong 27; in Qianlong 31 an edict restored the title of his sixth-generation ancestor Tumengken Sayin Noyan; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; removed for illness in Qianlong 51.)Chedeng Zhab (eldest son of Norbu Zhab; first succeeded as Duke Who Guards the State — see separate table; in Qianlong 51 was promoted to jasak first-rank prince of the blood and Sayin Noyan; died in Qianlong 57.)Elinqin Dorji (son of Chedeng Zhab; succeeded as jasak first-rank prince of the blood in Qianlong 58; stripped for crime in Jiaqing 5.)Pentsuk Dash (younger brother of Elinqin Dorji; succeeded in Jiaqing 7; removed for illness in Jiaqing 22.)Chelin Dorji (son of Pentsuk Dash; succeeded in Jiaqing 22; died in Xianfeng 3.)Demuchui (son of Chelin Dorji; succeeded in Xianfeng 3.)Chelin Duanduobu (younger clansman of Demuchui; succeeded in Tongzhi 10.)Tegus Wazhier (son of Chelin Duanduobu; succeeded in Guangxu 9.)Namnang Suren (son of Tegus Wazhier; succeeded in Guangxu 22.)
Khalkha Sayin Noyan Division — Duke Who Guards the StateNorbu Zhab (granted ducal rank in Qianlong 10; enfeoffed as Prince of the Third Rank in Qianlong 20; later succeeded as jasak first-rank prince of the blood and Sayin Noyan — see the first-rank princes table.)Chedeng Zhab (eldest son of Norbu Zhab; succeeded as Duke Who Guards the State in Qianlong 27; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; in Qianlong 51 succeeded as jasak first-rank prince of the blood and Sayin Noyan — see the first-rank princes table.)Elinqin Dorji (eldest son of Chedeng Zhab; succeeded as Duke Who Guards the State in Qianlong 51; succeeded as jasak first-rank prince of the blood in Qianlong 58.)Pentsuk Dash (younger brother of Elinqin Dorji; succeeded as Duke Who Guards the State in Qianlong 58; in Jiaqing 7 changed to succeed as jasak first-rank prince of the blood.)Zana Zhab (eldest son of Pentsuk Dash; succeeded in Jiaqing 8; died in Daoguang 29.)Chelin Duanduobu (son of Zana Zhab; succeeded in Daoguang 29.)Tegus Wazhier (son of Chelin Duanduobu; succeeded in Tongzhi 11.)Bangdang Namjile (son of Tegus Wazhier; succeeded in Guangxu 10.)Namnang Suren (younger brother of Bangdang Namjile; succeeded in Guangxu 12.)Elinqin Sashi (succeeded in the second month of Guangxu 24.)
Khalkha Sayin Noyan Division — first-class taiji with ducal rankSanpile Dorji (third son of Prince Deqin Zhab; first granted first-class taiji; granted ducal rank in Qianlong 22; died in Qianlong 49.)Damalin (eldest son of Sanpile Dorji; succeeded as first-class taiji with ducal rank in Qianlong 50; died in Qianlong 57.)Minzhur (younger brother of Damalin; succeeded as first-class taiji with ducal rank in Qianlong 57; died in Jiaqing 19; his son Gunbu Minzhur succeeded as first-class taiji and the ducal rank was cancelled.)
Khalkha Sayin Noyan Division — jasak Prince of the Blood of the First RankCeling (younger second clansman of Prince Shanba; granted Third Class Commandant of Light Chariots in Kangxi 31; granted third-rank prince rank in Kangxi 45; granted jasak in Kangxi 60; specially enfeoffed as commandery prince in Yongzheng 1; in Yongzheng 9 promoted to first-rank prince of the blood and appointed Grand Jasak of Khalkha; granted the title Chaoyong in Yongzheng 10; died in Qianlong 15 with posthumous title Xiang, a place in the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and entry in the Hall of Worthies.)Chenggun Zhab (eldest son of Celing; enfeoffed as Prince of the Third Rank in Qianlong 1; enfeoffed as heir apparent in Qianlong 4; succeeded as jasak first-rank prince of the blood in Qianlong 15; died in Qianlong 36.)Lawang Dorji (seventh son of Chenggun Zhab; enfeoffed as heir apparent in Qianlong 29; succeeded as jasak first-rank prince of the blood in Qianlong 36; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Jiaqing 21.)Bayan Dorji Gale (adopted son of Lawang Dorji; succeeded in Jiaqing 21.)Chedeng Bazha'er (son of Bayan Dorji Gale; succeeded in Jiaqing 21; died in Xianfeng 2.)Darma (son of Chedeng Bazha'er; succeeded in Xianfeng 2.)Nayantu (son of Darma; succeeded in Tongzhi 13.)

Khalkha Sayin Noyan Division — Duke Who Assists the StateErke Shara (eldest son of Prince Chenggun Zhab; enfeoffed as Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 22; granted third-rank prince rank in Qianlong 23; died in Qianlong 31, after which succession to third-rank prince rank ceased.)Yish Zhamuchu (younger brother of Erke Shara; succeeded as Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 31; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Qianlong 55.)Dash Dorji (grand-nephew of Yish Zhamuchu; succeeded as Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 56; died in Jiaqing 1.)Nima (eldest son of Dash Dorji; succeeded in Jiaqing 2.)Buni Dali (eldest son of Nima; succeeded in Daoguang 11; died in Daoguang 24.)Mijite Dorji (son of Buni Dali; succeeded in Daoguang 24.)Ekeli Semangnai (succeeded in the third month of Guangxu 33.)
Khalkha Sayin Noyan Division — Duke Who Assists the StateFobao (first succeeded to his father Gongge Labutan's second-rank prince title — see the second-rank princes table; returned from Ili in Qianlong 22 and was granted ducal rank; enfeoffed as Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 28; died in Qianlong 36.)Sanpile Dundok (eldest son of Fobao; succeeded as Duke Who Assists the State in Qianlong 36; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46.)Gelik Duanduobu (adopted son of Sanpile Dundok; succeeded in Jiaqing 7; died in Jiaqing 23.)Sandok Dorji (son of Gelik Duanduobu; succeeded in Jiaqing 23; removed for illness in Daoguang 30.)Jikite Wazhier (son of Sandok Dorji; succeeded in Daoguang 30.)Chelin Dorji (son of Jikite Wazhier; succeeded in Guangxu 4.)Luobusang Chuimubole (succeeded in the fourth month of Guangxu 19.)
Khalkha Sayin Noyan Division — first-class taiji with ducal rankElinqin Dorji (fifth son of Chaoyong Prince Xiang Celing; first granted first-class taiji; posthumously given ducal rank in Qianlong 21.)Naxun Dorji (eldest son of Elinqin Dorji; succeeded as first-class taiji with ducal rank in Qianlong 21.)
Khalkha Sayin Noyan Division — jasak Prince of the Commandery of the Second RankChebudeng Zhab (second son of Chaoyong Prince Xiang Celing, enfeoffed as Duke Who Assists the State; granted jasak in Qianlong 16; granted third-rank prince rank in Qianlong 19; enfeoffed as second-rank prince of the blood in Qianlong 20; promoted to commandery prince in Qianlong 21; in Qianlong 23 by edict succeeded to his father's Chaoyong title and was granted first-rank prince rank; stripped of first-rank prince rank in Qianlong 45 for presumptuously requesting boundary extension; granted perpetual hereditary tenure as commandery prince in Qianlong 46; died in Qianlong 47.)Sanpile Dorji (eldest son of Chebudeng Zhab; succeeded as jasak commandery prince in Qianlong 47.)Damalin Zhab (eldest son of Sanpile Dorji; succeeded in Jiaqing 12; died in Jiaqing 20.)Chuke Sumu Zhab (son of Damalin Zhab; succeeded in Jiaqing 20; died in Daoguang 11.)Chelin Gunbu (younger brother of Chuke Sumu Zhab; succeeded in Daoguang 11; died in Daoguang 17.)Darma Bazha'er (son of Chelin Gunbu; succeeded in Daoguang 17; died in Xianfeng 4.)Sangga Xiri (younger brother of Darma Bazha'er; succeeded in Xianfeng 4.)Chelin Dorji (son of Sangga Xiri; succeeded in Guangxu 9; died in Guangxu 18.)Kurugumu Zhab (son of Chelin Dorji; succeeded in Guangxu 18.)

Khalkha Sayin Noyan Division — jasak first-class taijiNamuzhale (younger cousin of jasak taiji Yidamu; granted first-class jasak taiji in Kangxi 35; died in Kangxi 55.)Balang (eldest son of Namuzhale; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Kangxi 55; removed for illness in Qianlong 13.)Alabutan (eldest son of Balang; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 13; died in Qianlong 24.)Dundob (eldest son of Alabutan; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 24; removed for illness in Qianlong 31.)Wangjile Sanpile (eldest son of Dundob; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 31; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Daoguang 2.)Gejibale (son of Wangjile Sanpile; succeeded in Daoguang 2.)Zhamusailin Zhab (son of Gejibale; succeeded in Tongzhi 1.)Chelin Gunbu (son of Zhamusailin Zhab; succeeded in Tongzhi 4.)Luobsang Haidobu (succeeded in Guangxu 14.)

Khalkha Sayin Noyan Division — jasak first-class taijiSudani (younger cousin of Prince Shanba; granted first-class jasak taiji in Kangxi 36; died in Kangxi 39.)Sala Wangzha (eldest son of Sudani; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Kangxi 39; died in Yongzheng 1.)Chebudeng (eldest son of Sala Wangzha; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Yongzheng 1; stripped for crime in Yongzheng 11.)Laichong Zhab (eldest son of Chebudeng; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Yongzheng 11; died in Qianlong 24.)Nawang Cheling (second son of Chebudeng; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 24; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; removed for illness in Qianlong 49.)Gungelashi (fourth son of Nawang Cheling; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 49; died in Jiaqing 6.)Gunchuke Zhab (eldest son of Gungelashi; succeeded in Jiaqing 6; died in Daoguang 19.)Zhanbala (son of Gunchuke Zhab; succeeded in Daoguang 19; died in Daoguang 27.)Chedeng Pilejiya (nephew of Zhanbala; succeeded in Daoguang 27.)Yunduan Dorji (son of Chedeng Pilejiya; succeeded in Guangxu 9.)Chelin Dorji (younger brother of Yunduan Dorji; succeeded in Guangxu 13.)
Khalkha Sayin Noyan Division — third-class taiji with ducal rankGawa (of the same clan as jasak taiji Laichong Zhab; first granted third-class taiji; granted ducal rank in Qianlong 21; died in Qianlong 34.)Sangji (eldest son of Gawa; succeeded as third-class taiji with ducal rank in Qianlong 34; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46.)Wangpile (son of Sangji; succeeded in Jiaqing 22.)Cheling Sanglubu (son of Wangpile; succeeded in Daoguang 3.)Weiduobu Sangbao (son of Cheling Sanglubu; succeeded in Tongzhi 3.)
Khalkha Sayin Noyan Division — jasak first-class taijiJinamida (younger second clansman of Prince Shanba; granted first-class jasak taiji in Kangxi 48; died in Yongzheng 2.)Tekeshi (eldest son of Jinamida; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Yongzheng 2; died in Qianlong 15.)Wubashi (eldest son of Tekeshi; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 15; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Qianlong 53.)Buda Qisuhu (eldest son of Wubashi; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 54; died in Jiaqing 10.)Gunbu Dorji (younger brother of Buda Qisuhu; succeeded in Jiaqing 10; died in Daoguang 25.)Galesang Dorji (son of Gunbu Dorji; succeeded in Daoguang 25; died in Xianfeng 1.)Zhangchub Dorji (elder brother of Galesang Dorji; succeeded in Xianfeng 1.)Elin Dorji (son of Zhangchub Dorji; succeeded in Xianfeng 2.)Dayang Zhabao (succeeded in the second month of Guangxu 23.)
Khalkha Sayin Noyan Division — jasak first-class taijiDorji (younger cousin of Prince Shanba; granted first-class jasak taiji in Kangxi 51; removed for illness in Yongzheng 3.)Nima (eldest son of Dorji; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Yongzheng 3; died in Yongzheng 10.)Abao (eldest son of Nima; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Yongzheng 10; died in Qianlong 18.)Chelin Bale (second son of Dorji; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 18; died in Qianlong 25.)Chenggun Zhab (eldest son of Chelin Bale; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 25; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Qianlong 50.)Demuchuke (eldest son of Chenggun Zhab; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 50; died in Jiaqing 5.)Chedeng Dash (younger brother of Demuchuke; succeeded in Jiaqing 6; died in Jiaqing 25.)Sangjin Zhab (younger brother of Chedeng Dash; succeeded in Daoguang 11.)Chelin (son of Sangjin Zhab; succeeded in Daoguang 11; died in Daoguang 12.)Buyan Jiergale (younger brother of Chelin; succeeded in Daoguang 12.)Qimote Balejin (succeeded in the third month of Guangxu 20.)
Khalkha Sayin Noyan Division — jasak first-class taijiEmogen (great-grandson of Commandery Prince Gunbu; granted first-class taiji with jasak in Qianlong 3; died in Qianlong 22.)Dash (eldest son of Emogen; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 22; granted ducal rank in Qianlong 23; died in Qianlong 25.)Bandi (eldest son of Dash; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 25; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Qianlong 55.)Damalin (eldest son of Bandi; succeeded as first-class jasak taiji in Qianlong 55; died in Jiaqing 24.)Hasibazhar (son of Damalin; succeeded in Jiaqing 24; died in Daoguang 19.)Bumuda'er (son of Hasibazhar; succeeded in Daoguang 19.)Qimute Dorji (son of Bumuda'er; succeeded in Tongzhi 4.)Zhamusalin Zhab (younger brother of Qimute Dorji; succeeded in Tongzhi 6.)Ba'er Walakecha (succeeded in Guangxu 31.)
Khalkha Sayin Noyan Division — Oirat jasak Prince of the Third RankAlabutan (ninth-generation descendant of the Dzungar taiji Erke Morot Darhan Noyan; submitted to the Qing in Kangxi 41 and was enfeoffed as jasak commandery prince; died in Kangxi 42.)Cheling Wangbu (eldest son of Alabutan; succeeded as jasak commandery prince in Kangxi 42; died in Yongzheng 6.)Sebten Wangbu (second son of Alabutan; enfeoffed as second-rank prince of the blood in Yongzheng 1; granted jasak status in Yongzheng 4; in Yongzheng 7 succeeded as commandery prince and combined the two jasak lines; died in Qianlong 13.)Punsuk (adopted son of Sebten Wangbu; demoted to jasak third-rank prince in Qianlong 13; in Qianlong 26 an edict assigned him to the Khalkha Sayin Noyan Division; stripped of jasak status for crime in Qianlong 43 but kept the third-rank prince title.)Namuzhale (eldest son of Punsuk; succeeded as jasak third-rank prince in Qianlong 43; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46; died in Qianlong 53.)Cheling Dorji (eldest son of Namuzhale; succeeded as jasak third-rank prince in Qianlong 53; died in Qianlong 56.)Punsuk (grandfather of Cheling Dorji; resumed as jasak third-rank prince in Qianlong 56; died in Jiaqing 3.)Dorji Bale (grandson of Punsuk; succeeded in Jiaqing 4; died in Jiaqing 22.)Chakedu'er Zhale (younger cousin of Dorji Bale; succeeded in Jiaqing 22.)Dakdan Dorji (son of Chakedu'er Zhale; succeeded in Guangxu 5; died in Guangxu 30.)Sanduke Dorji (succeeded in the third month of Guangxu 33.)
Khalkha Sayin Noyan Division — Oirat jasak Prince of the Third RankDanjila (ninth-generation descendant of the Dzungar taiji Erke Morot Darhan Noyan; submitted in Kangxi 36 and was appointed Inner Minister; enfeoffed as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Kangxi 44; died in Kangxi 47.)Dorji Sebten (eldest son of Danjila; succeeded as jasak Duke Who Assists the State in Kangxi 47; promoted to third-rank prince in Yongzheng 1 and to second-rank prince of the blood in Yongzheng 8; died in Qianlong 2.)Sandob (eldest son of Dorji Sebten; succeeded as jasak third-rank prince in Qianlong 2; died in Qianlong 25.)Gunchuke Bang (adopted son of Sandob; succeeded as jasak third-rank prince in Qianlong 26 under the Khalkha Sayin Noyan Division; granted perpetual hereditary tenure in Qianlong 46.)Jikemute Gongsang (eldest son of Gunchuke Bang; succeeded in Jiaqing 9.)Cheboke Zhale (son of Jikemute Gongsang; succeeded in Jiaqing 13; died in Jiaqing 19.)Zhamuyan Dorji (elder brother of Cheboke Zhale; succeeded in Jiaqing 19; died in Jiaqing 23.)Genge Dorji (younger cousin of Zhamuyan Dorji; succeeded in Jiaqing 23.)Chedob Dorji (son of Genge Dorji; succeeded in Daoguang 22.)Qimute Delike (nephew of Chedob Dorji; succeeded in Guangxu 12.)
